_about: What each perk's icon (Skills window milestone cards) shows, for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set perks. One emblem object for what the perk does, drawn from its skill's world (a bow perk shows archery things), so the two perks of a milestone look different from each other. Techniques (perks that change how something works) get a faint golden glow.
